title: 2024 Topps Series 2 #SMLB-43 Trea Turner Philadelphia Phillies Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This is a 2024 Topps Series 2 sports trading card featuring Trea Turner of the Philadelphia Phillies. The card number is SMLB-43 and it is part of the Stars of MLB insert set. It is a great addition to any baseball fan's collection, especially those who follow the Major League Baseball (MLB). The card is not autographed and is manufactured by Topps. It is a type of sports trading card and is part of the 2024 season.
